cohort: The cohort consisted of 3,841,147 control births and 754 births in women with an arcuate uterus, identified from a large population database.
finding: Women with an arcuate uterus appear to be at increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, particularly cesarean section and disseminated intravascular coagulopathy.
mod_finding: Women with an arcuate uterus had significantly higher rates of cesarean sections (aOR 10.88 and aOR 30.04) compared to controls.
birth_weight: Small for gestational age (SGA) neonates were an identified outcome, indicating lower birth weight relative to gestational age.
gest_age: Preterm delivery and small for gestational age (SGA) neonates were identified as outcomes, implying gestational age considerations.
